headline: Fire breaks out at Apex footwear showroom in Dhanmondi
summary: Fire service units are working to control a blaze that erupted at the showroom on Thursday morning.
details: A fire broke out at an Apex footwear showroom in the Dhanmondi-27 area of the capital on Thursday morning around 10:00 AM.
Upon receiving the news, two units from the Mohammadpur Fire Station arrived at the scene to begin firefighting operations.
An additional four units were subsequently dispatched to the location to assist in bringing the blaze under control.
Law enforcement agencies are also present at the scene to maintain order and support the fire service personnel.
According to the fire service, there have been no reports of injuries or anyone trapped inside the building so far.
caption:
A fire erupted at an Apex footwear showroom in Dhanmondi this morning. Fire service units are currently on site.

A fire broke out at an Apex footwear showroom in the Dhanmondi-27 area of the capital on Thursday morning around 10:00 AM.

Upon receiving the news, two units from the Mohammadpur Fire Station arrived at the scene to begin firefighting operations.

An additional four units were subsequently dispatched to the location to assist in bringing the blaze under control.

Law enforcement agencies are also present at the scene to maintain order and support the fire service personnel.

According to the fire service, there have been no reports of injuries or anyone trapped inside the building so far.

headline_marked: Saima Wazed [[resigns from WHO regional head]] post amid fraud probes
headline: Saima Wazed resigns from WHO regional head post amid fraud probes
summary: The daughter of former PM Sheikh Hasina stepped down following allegations of financial irregularities and providing false information on educational certificates.
details: Saima Wazed has officially resigned from her position as the Regional Director for South-East Asia at the World Health Organization (WHO), according to Reuters.

The resignation comes amid investigations into allegations of financial irregularities during trips to China, providing false information regarding her educational qualifications, and the illegal acquisition of plots in Bangladesh.
Wazed, who took office in February 2024 for a five-year term after being elected in November 2023, had been placed on unpaid leave in July 2025 following corruption probes by the ACC in Bangladesh.

Through her lawyers, Wazed denied the allegations, stating that a $901 discrepancy in China travel expenses was an administrative error by an assistant and that the WHO Director-General was already aware her doctorate was honorary.

In her resignation letter, she claimed that the WHO leadership had hindered her from performing her duties effectively and that the lack of payment during her leave had made her financial situation unsustainable.

WHO sources indicate that a formal process to remove her from the post was already underway. A new nomination for the role may be announced by October 12, with elections for a new Regional Director expected by January 24.
caption:
Saima Wazed has resigned from her top WHO post following fraud and financial irregularity allegations.

Saima Wazed has officially resigned from her position as the Regional Director for South-East Asia at the World Health Organization (WHO), according to Reuters.

The resignation comes amid investigations into allegations of financial irregularities during trips to China, providing false information regarding her educational qualifications, and the illegal acquisition of plots in Bangladesh.

Wazed, who took office in February 2024 for a five-year term after being elected in November 2023, had been placed on unpaid leave in July 2025 following corruption probes by the ACC in Bangladesh.

Through her lawyers, Wazed denied the allegations, stating that a $901 discrepancy in China travel expenses was an administrative error by an assistant and that the WHO Director-General was already aware her doctorate was honorary.

In her resignation letter, she claimed that the WHO leadership had hindered her from performing her duties effectively and that the lack of payment during her leave had made her financial situation unsustainable.

WHO sources indicate that a formal process to remove her from the post was already underway. A new nomination for the role may be announced by October 12, with elections for a new Regional Director expected by January 24.
